# Machine_Learning_Practice
# Miscellaneous Machine Learning and Deep Learning Practices. (Code completion is not generated by AI). It contains the following projects:

- **LLaMA-2-Style Language Model: Core Components & Fine-Tuning**
   Implemented core components of a LLaMA-2-style Transformer, including **RMSNorm, self-attention, Transformer layers, RoPE and AdamW**, and implemented text generation and a downstream classification head. Fine-tuned the resulting model on **SST and CFIMDB** for sentence classification, gaining hands-on experience with foundation-model architecture, optimisation and downstream adaptation.
